text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити finishes the Hanshin J.F. to
roaring
cheers from the crowd.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She hears them call her "pretty" and
"beautiful."
Having failed to change their
perspective, she
grows irritated.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They want to see her win the Triple Tiara
not to
celebrate her running, but for the
pretty picture.
Pandering to that would
make her a doll with no
agency.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wanting to decide her own path, she
chooses to
run for the Classic Triple
Crown. First up will be
the Satsuki Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
